key.name: show-completed
key.description: When enabled, completed tasks stay visible at the bottom of the list. When disabled they are hidden from the popup but never deleted.

key.name: show-count-in-panel
key.summary: Show the pending count in the top bar
key.description: Display the number of pending tasks next to the panel icon. When disabled, only the icon is shown.

key.name: max-visible-tasks
key.description: How many task rows the popup shows before it starts scrolling.

key.name: storage-file
key.description: Absolute path of the JSON file tasks are stored in. Empty means the default location under the XDG data directory. Changing this does not move existing tasks: the extension simply starts reading and writing at the new path.
